cohort: The study participants were 266 neonates treated with antibiotics in the NICU of Al Basheer Government Hospital in Amman, Jordan.
finding: The study found high rates of antibiotic resistance among bacterial isolates from neonates with sepsis, with most neonates having late-onset sepsis and significant resistance observed against commonly prescribed empiric antibiotics.
cross-section timing: Retrospective data collection from the hospital's microbiology lab database and medical records.
